page.purpose: Lifetime vehicle operating-cost evidence: recorded positive-cost charging versus modeled gasoline, with distinct fixed-cost ledger and opt-in narration. It is not measured complete ownership cost.
page.comparison_limit: 209 is the queue's historical page-only baseline. No historical extracted-component total was reconstructed or claimed. Current closure includes directly rendered feature parts, state/display/type support and the pure analysis adapter, excluding tests, barrels and unused former equivalents.
page.section_preservation: All seventeen slots are declared unconditionally in one CardGrid; each is independently wrapped by SectionErrorBoundary. No whole-page loading/error/empty props replace the children: PageLayout receives only the aggregate query for header freshness.

section_order.contract: Eight raw numeric KPIs with distinct source filters, lifetime/span captions and aggregate retry/trust notice.
Endpoint, charging/drive/month filters, payload and row dispositions.
Always-present operating versus ownership boundary; zero-floor withholding.
Signed fuel delta, separate maintenance heuristic, qualified combination.
Independent entries/totals, add form and confirmed deletion; findings below.
Supported monthly cumulative gas-minus-EV, source export and formatted data alternative.
Paired supported EV/gas rows, legend visibility identity and export.
Signed deltas, explicit zero line and export.
Cost and converted Wh series, separate axes and raw-Wh export.
Lifetime distance denominator converted at display, source cost/km export.
Every returned row with terminal disposition and independently validated fields.
Source fuel price/unit/MPG/rate, monthly energy method and heuristic.
First/last positive drives, modeled span, returned month range and disclosed gap meaning.
Algebraic baseline-supported price/MPG thresholds, not forecast.
Nine bounded price/MPG scenarios; mobile omission finding below.
Eight identities with expected/observed/residual/tolerance and unavailable operands.
Eight always-visible limitations including negative losses and database-calendar semantics.

confirmed_findings.title: Fixed-ledger all-in value turns unavailable independent inputs into measured totals
confirmed_findings.mechanism: Page passes missing aggregate distance/cost as zero. Ledger adds grand_total ?? 0 and renders the all-in header before its own loading/fatal branch. Thus missing/failed aggregate with a ready ledger becomes fixed-only 'All-in'; missing ledger with a ready aggregate becomes charging-only 'All-in'; neither source can qualify the headline. With no vehicle or initial paused ledger, isLoading is false and no fetchStatus/enabled gate exists: an empty directory and zero hint can be shown despite no authoritative empty response.
confirmed_findings.source_repro_condition: Aggregate data undefined while ledger has entries; or ledger data undefined during loading/failure/paused/no-selection. Algebra and branch ordering establish the defect; no mounted repro executed.
confirmed_findings.proposed_narrow_owner: New parent-assigned fixed-ledger cross-source trust item, retaining all sections/form/actions and current raw wire fields. Pass source availability/retained context, withhold unsupported combined totals, distinguish paused/no-selection/unknown from successful empty, and retain independent retry.
confirmed_findings.acceptance_needed: Focused synthetic source-state coverage followed by separately authorized mounted QA; no accepted Phase5 migration replay.

confirmed_findings.title: Ledger currency dimension is discarded in display, creation and combined totals
confirmed_findings.mechanism: Entry currency survives only in filter identity; visible amount uses the current currency symbol regardless of e.currency, without conversion. Add payload omits currency, so server stores USD independently of the displayed symbol. SummarizeLedger combines all currencies into a dimensionless grand_total, which the frontend adds to charging spend; charging aggregate exposes no ISO currency dimension. A symbol preference is not an ISO code or an exchange rate.
confirmed_findings.source_repro_condition: A non-USD display symbol, an entry with a different ISO currency, or mixed-currency entries. Source branch/schema inspection only, not actual financial data.
confirmed_findings.owner: TrueCostLedgerColumns.tsx and TrueCostFixedLedger.tsx at the presentation/create boundary; ledger.go/ledger_handler.go and typed response for authoritative currency identity
confirmed_findings.proposed_narrow_owner: Parent-assigned currency-contract integration owner first, plus narrowly scoped ledger consumption. Preserve original amounts/ISO identities; disclose or withhold mixed/unknown-currency totals rather than guess ISO from symbols or fabricate FX. Coordinate exact writable schema/backend files separately.
confirmed_findings.acceptance_needed: Synthetic single/mixed/unknown-currency and create-payload checks under explicit later authorization.
